nodes.label: int main
nodes.desc: L887: console entry, sets up crash handling and profiler store, creates OBSApp.

nodes.label: OBSApp::OBSApp
nodes.desc: L959: Qt application object; loads locale, themes, config, then opens main window.

nodes.label: obs_scene_create
nodes.desc: L1794: scenes are just sources; the frontend builds the scene tree from the collection file.

nodes.label: obs_startup
nodes.desc: L1330: one-shot core init; guarded against double calls, calls obs_init.

nodes.label: obs_init_graphics
nodes.desc: L479: creates the gs graphics subsystem on the chosen renderer (D3D11/OpenGL/Metal).

nodes.label: obs_init_video
nodes.desc: L695: builds canvas and video mixes for the requested FPS and resolution.

nodes.label: pthread_create (video)
nodes.desc: L720: spawns the single graphics thread that drives every frame.

nodes.label: obs_init_audio
nodes.desc: L907: opens the audio subsystem with sample rate and speaker layout.

nodes.label: obs_graphics_thread
nodes.desc: L1161: while loop over obs_graphics_thread_loop L1097; interval from video_frame_interval_ns.

nodes.label: tick_sources
nodes.desc: L32: iterates obs->data.sources, computes seconds since last tick, calls obs_source_video_tick L82.

nodes.label: obs_source_video_tick
nodes.desc: L1406: per-source housekeeping: async video frames, audio actions, filters, transitions.

nodes.label: scene_video_tick
nodes.desc: L990: scene's own tick; advances item transforms, move/transition actions.

nodes.label: output_frames
nodes.desc: L919: one output_frame pass per active video mix.

nodes.label: output_frame
nodes.desc: L871: render_video L888 then download_frame L894 inside one gs context.

nodes.label: render_video
nodes.desc: L541: renders main texture L549, optional color conversion, then GPU-encode or stage.

nodes.label: render_main_texture
nodes.desc: L172: clears render_texture, runs draw callbacks, then obs_view_render L202.

nodes.label: obs_view_render
nodes.desc: L118: for each of MAX_CHANNELS channels calls obs_source_video_render L135 on the bound source.

nodes.label: scene_video_render
nodes.desc: L1059: video_lock, walk first_item linked list, render_item for each visible item L1077-1083.

nodes.label: render_displays
nodes.desc: L94: after the mix is rendered, paints preview displays; a slow preview also eats frame budget.

nodes.label: gs_effect (shaders)
nodes.desc: Effect params looked up by name L275 and set L436 before draws; effects are the uniform bridge to GPU shaders.

nodes.label: render_convert_texture
nodes.desc: L566: GPU conversion of the RGBA output texture to planar YUV for encoders.

nodes.label: download_frame
nodes.desc: L585: stagesurf copy of the converted texture to CPU memory for raw outputs.

nodes.label: video_sleep
nodes.desc: L808: os_sleepto_ns L815 to next interval; on overrun the missed frames are counted in lagged_frames L828.

nodes.label: FPS accounting
nodes.desc: L1148: once per second the loop publishes obs->video.video_fps and average frame time.

nodes.label: audio_output_open
nodes.desc: L353: opens audio_output and spawns its thread L376.

nodes.label: audio_thread
nodes.desc: L205: os_sleepto_ns_fast to wall-clock deadlines every AUDIO_OUTPUT_FRAMES=1024 samples (audio-io.h L31).

nodes.label: input_and_output (mix)
nodes.desc: L160: sums every registered input into float mix buffers, clamps, converts and delivers.

nodes.label: obs_output_start
nodes.desc: L397: entry point for streaming/recording; validates and starts the output.

nodes.label: obs_output_can_begin_data_capture
nodes.desc: L2578: checks encoders/interleaved channels are present before capture begins.

nodes.label: obs_output_begin_data_capture
nodes.desc: L2774: connects encoded or raw callbacks; from here frames leave libobs toward RTMP/file.
